modes.about: Asks before it edits a file or runs a command, except commands it counts as safe, such as sleep or echo, which run without asking.
modes.label: Asks first

modes.about: Edits files, and runs file commands such as rm, mv, cp and sed, inside this workspace and any folder you let it work in, without asking; it still asks before such a command anywhere else.
modes.label: Edits freely

modes.about: Researches and proposes a plan, and changes nothing until you approve it.
modes.label: Plans first

how.text: Create an API key in the Claude Console

modes.about: Starts as Claude Code starts by itself: the project's default mode, else Auto where it is available, else Manual.
modes.label: Claude Code's own

modes.about: Asks before edits, shell commands and network actions.
modes.label: Manual

modes.about: Makes file edits and common filesystem commands without asking.
modes.label: Accept edits

modes.about: Researches and proposes changes, and edits nothing until you approve the plan.
modes.label: Plan

modes.about: Runs everything, with a classifier reviewing each action first; Manual where auto is not available.
modes.label: Auto

modes.about: Refuses anything that would ask, and runs only what is approved beforehand.
modes.label: Don't ask

modes.about: Skips every permission prompt and safety check.
modes.label: Bypass permissions

how.text: Claude Code asks you to sign in with your Claude account when it starts, once in each workspace.
Create an API key at platform.openai.com/api-keys

modes.about: Runs every command without asking and outside Codex's sandbox.
modes.label: Full access

offered.note: Sail starts Codex CLI in a workspace with full access, running every command without asking and without its sandbox: that sandbox, bubblewrap, cannot start in a workspace's container.

how.text: Codex CLI asks you to sign in with your ChatGPT account when it starts, once in each workspace. Choose “Sign in with Device Code” there, after turning it on in your ChatGPT security settings.
